import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
def save(n,d):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(d,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(lane.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'path':p.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),**{k:d.get(k) for k in ['name','exit','killed','wall_s','sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes','samples','child_cpu_cumulative_s','affinity','cpu_limit_s','as_limit_bytes','deadline_s']}})
assert all(r['exit']==0 or r['name']=='source_scope_history_compact' for r in receipts)
ledger=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];prev='0'*64
for i,raw in enumerate(Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)):
 d=json.loads(raw);assert d['seq']==i and d['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert len([x for x in ledger if x['event']=='attempt'])==10
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
save('RESOURCE-INVENTORY.json',{'completed_receipts':receipts,'failure_count':sum(r['exit']!=0 for r in receipts),'seal_current_receipt':'Excluded until runner completion: seal.receipt.json and seal.output.txt','standalone_exceptions':['bootstrap-receipt.json','frozen-before.json','frozen-after.json'],'limitations':['Sampled group RSS can miss transients','Native search CPU/RSS unavailable','Separate writer peaks unavailable','No universal cgroup or systemwide compliance claim'],'synchronous_reaping':True,'guard_chain_records':len(ledger),'guard_chain_tip_sha256':prev,'search_budget':json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text()),'frozen_after':json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())})
exclude={'MANIFEST.json','seal.receipt.json','seal.output.txt'};files=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and p.relative_to(lane).as_posix() not in exclude:
  b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':p.relative_to(lane).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
save('MANIFEST.json',{'algorithm':'SHA256','scope':'Every ownlane regular artifact existing at terminal seal, including all completed receipts except the precisely named self-excluded terminal seal pair','self_exclusions':sorted(exclude),'files':files,'qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0,'frozen_after_pass':True})
print(json.dumps({'manifest_entries':len(files),'completed_receipts':len(receipts),'failed_receipts':sum(r['exit']!=0 for r in receipts),'frozen_after':'PASS12/12','guard_hops':10,'native_search_calls':3,'qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0}))
